marta_csops: Seeing repeated onboarding nudges — same template sent twice to ~120 accounts over past 90m. Suspect schedule overlap after yesterday's backoff tweak.

raj_dataeng: Can you share a sample account id? I'll run a quick duplicate check.

marta_csops: sample: acct-5532 got 2 sends at 10:12 and 10:14.

raj_dataeng: quick query I ran: SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) FROM playbook_events WHERE playbook='welcome-v2' AND created_at > now() - interval '2 hours' GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1; returns ~120 rows. Root cause: two runs scheduled within 2m due to CI resubmit.

marta_csops: Paused sends and set playbook to shadow_only. Command used: curl -X POST https://admin.internal/api/playbooks/toggle -d '{"name":"welcome-v2","enabled":false}'.

lina_enablement: drafting short apology + unsubscribe link. Also adding gating rule suggestion: dedupe_window_hours=48 and min_health_score=30.

daniel_csm: good. Raj, can you add a CI lint to block schedule deltas < 5m? Also create an alert if dupes > 50/hr.

raj_dataeng: on it. Will post CSV of affected accounts and set the alert to send to #csops (manual review not auto-toggle).

playbook-bot: system: outbound queue paused, 0 sends in flight.

marta_csops: thanks — re-enable to shadow-only after CI lint is in place. I'll coordinate outreach owners.
